judge_dialect: ztljudge string formulas over named atoms; conjunction '&'

rules.tree_identity: atom is T iff `git rev-parse <head>^{tree}` equals the recorded tree; witness = the commit object itself (head sha).
rules.path_confinement: atom is T iff every path in `git diff --name-only <base> <head>` matches the prefix set; witness = (base, head) tree pair.
rules.changed_file_set: atom is T iff the changed-path set vs base equals exactly the listed set; witness = (base, head).
rules.member_identity: atom is T iff the artifact at <path> in the item tree has the declared bytes/sha256/sha512; witness = the blob hash.
rules.manifest_accounting: atom is T iff declared members + the self-excluded manifest == physical files, with 0 missing / 0 undeclared / 0 duplicates and every member's bytes+sha256+sha512 reproducing; witness = manifest blob + member blobs.
rules.json_field: atom is T iff JSON artifact <path> has <field> == <expected>; witness = artifact blob.
rules.json_all_true: atom is T iff every element of <array> in <path> has <field> == true; witness = artifact blob.
rules.file_bytes: atom is T iff artifact <path> has exactly <n> bytes; witness = blob.
rules.file_equals: atom is T iff artifact <path> content equals <literal> exactly; witness = blob.
rules.file_empty_or_absent: atom is T iff artifact <path> is absent from the tree, or present with 0 bytes where the gate expects emptiness; witness = tree listing / blob.
rules.file_absent: atom is T iff <path> is absent from the item tree; witness = tree object.
rules.argv_equals: atom is T iff JSON artifact <path> equals the exact argv list; witness = blob.
rules.junit_counts: atom is T iff the JUnit at <path> parses with exactly (collected,P,F,S); witness = blob.
rules.junit_failing_set: atom is T iff the failing-ID set of the JUnit at <path> equals exactly <set>; witness = blob.
rules.junit_set_diff: atom is T iff failing(<A>) - failing(<B>) == <left> and failing(<B>) - failing(<A>) == <right>; witness = both blobs.
rules.zip_member_identity: as member_identity, over the legacy zip's members; witness = zip sha256 + member name.
rules.zip_manifest_accounting: as manifest_accounting over the legacy zip; witness = zip sha256.
rules.ast_confinement: atom is T iff AST module-unit diff of the two persisted sources changes exactly the listed units and no others, with the named unit byte-identical; witness = both source blobs.
rules.doc_cites: atom is T iff the persisted return/record document contains the exact cited line (e.g., a CI run id with SUCCESS); witness = blob. NOTE: this binds the persisted CITATION; the external CI service itself is not a corpus artifact.
rules.commit_exists: T iff <head> resolves to a commit object in the corpus ledger (recited head, tree not separately stipulated); unresolvable -> Z.
rules.file_present: T iff <path> is present in the item tree (existence only).
rules.argv_has_substr: T iff some element of the JSON argv at <path> contains the substring <substr>.
rules.json_field_in: T iff JSON <path>.<field> is one of <allowed>.
rules.junit_population: T iff the set of test IDs in the JUnit at <path> equals exactly <expected> (population).
rules.junit_collected: T iff the JUnit at <path> collects exactly <collected> cases (total).
rules.zip_member_present: T iff <member> exists in the legacy zip.
rules.seam_contradiction: T iff a governing clause value and the measured evidence value disagree (seam exposed).
rules.seam_f4_support: T iff no previously-S1-resolved test regressed in R1 (the F4 mislabel is unsupported).
rules.seam_schema_drift: T iff two corpus manifests bind members under different field names (byte_length vs bytes).
